trial_usage_mode.description: Usage metered during a free trial: `free` is not charged, `accrue` is charged when the trial converts. Defaults to `free`.

unit_price.description: Tax-exclusive price per SINGLE meter unit, in minor units of the product currency. "$20 per 1,000,000 tokens" is 0.002 (2000 cents / 1,000,000). Fractional values are allowed.
